id: title:Gilbert09:classify table size fd exhaustion as transient

review.posthog_relevance: Protects warehouse size calculation workflow from transient file-descriptor exhaustion, distinguishing transient worker capacity issues from actual defects.
review.reason: Adds a try/except block around warehouse size calculation to handle transient OSError (EMFILE, ENFILE) by raising NonReportableError instead of propagating OSError, while re-raising other errors. This prevents transient worker capacity issues from triggering false-positive error tracking or workflow failures.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on the supplied hunk; no broader context or test results are available to verify complete implementation or downstream impact.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No untrusted instructions. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds errno import, NonReportableError import, and a try/except block around get_size_of_folder. The except block checks errno.EMFILE and errno.ENFILE, logs a warning, and raises NonReportableError instead of propagating OSError. Other OSError subclasses are re-raised.
observations.posthog_connection: This protects the warehouse size calculation workflow from transient file-descriptor exhaustion, which could otherwise trigger false-positive error tracking or workflow failures. It distinguishes transient worker capacity issues from actual defects.
